infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to capture surroundings for visual re-localization.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used to anchor your GPS position for indoor tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Used for continuous indoor position tracking while navigating.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Used to count steps and detect walking direction.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Indoor Navigator to use the camera for re-localization.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Indoor Navigator to use your GPS location.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Indoor Navigator to save keyframe photos.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Indoor Navigator to save navigation data.
